subject: SOC 2 Type II intake: report, coverage clarification, and transfer options
messages:
From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acme-corp.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: audits@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-10-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and coverage clarification

Hi Logan,

We're starting a vendor assessment for Acme's payments product and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II materials to complete our controls review. Specifically:  

- Required coverage: audit period Jan 1, 2026 through Jun 30, 2026. Please confirm whether your current Type II report covers this period in full. If not, please provide a bridge letter that documents controls coverage for any gap dates and explains compensating controls.
- Deliverables (requested): SOC 2 Type II report PDF, bridge letter (if needed), system description, control mapping to Trust Services Criteria, subprocessor inventory, sample access-review/export, change-management excerpt, and an index of evidence samples.
- Delivery method: SFTP, secure shared folder (pre-authenticated), or an encrypted S3 presigned link. We prefer SFTP if available.
- Timeline: we need materials by EOD Oct 22 to keep our review on schedule. If that date is tight, please let me know the earliest you can commit to.

Also note: Acme's procurement team may send a DocuSign request for a DPA/acknowledgement after we receive the report. If there are any restrictions on sharing (redacted contract terms, no subcontractor PII, etc.), flag them up front.

Thanks,
Sarah Jensen
Senior IT Auditor | Acme Corp
[audits@acme-corp.com]

On Thu, Oct 15, 2026 at 08:58 AM audits@acme-corp.com wrote:
> Please include any bridge wording you typically use and whether legal sign-off is required before final delivery.

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-15T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and coverage clarification

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear ask. Quick summary and proposed plan:  

1) Coverage clarification
- Our most recent SOC 2 Type II examination covers Apr 1, 2026 through Sep 30, 2026 (report issue date: 2026-10-01). That means the period Apr 1–Jun 30, 2026 is covered in full; Jan 1–Mar 31, 2026 falls outside that Type II window.

2) Bridge letter
- We'll provide a short bridge letter that documents the controls in place for Jan 1–Mar 31, 2026 and explains overlap/continuity for the April–June timeframe. We will flag any exceptions or known changes. We typically treat the bridge letter as an explanatory cover letter, not a substitute for a Type II opinion.

3) What we'll share (initial package)
- redwood-soc2-typeii-2026-04-01_09-30.pdf (redacted where necessary)
- bridge-letter-jan-mar-2026-draft.pdf (editable draft for legal review)
- system-description-2026.docx
- control-mapping-matrix-2026.csv
- subprocessor-inventory-2026.xlsx (we redact contractual rates and sensitive commercial clauses)
- access-review-sample-2026.pdf (redacted user IDs)
- change-control-excerpt-2026.pdf
- evidence-bundle-sample-index.txt (lists archived artifacts we can share on request)

4) Transfer options and recommendation
- We can provide: SFTP (host + username; keys on request), encrypted S3 presigned link, or secure SharePoint/Drive folder with per-file encryption. For Acme's workflow, SFTP is fine — we'll send host/creds via a separate secure channel.

5) Timeline
- Initial package (PDFs, mapping, subprocessor list, bridge draft): by 2026-10-20 (ETA).
- Finalized package: by 2026-10-22 at the latest, assuming no legal hold.

6) Quick reply templates (useful for your procurement/audit tracker)
- Acknowledgement (short): "Received — thanks. We'll ingest and follow up with questions by Oct 29."
- Request for more artifacts: "Can you provide the change-control ticket 74321 and the full access-review CSV for Q2? We prefer secure SFTP transfer."

If that plan works, I'll assemble the package and have IT provision SFTP credentials (or post an S3 link) and share them to your secure contact. If you'd rather we use your SFTP host, send details and we'll push.

One note: our legal team asks that contracts/subprocessor agreements be redacted before transit; we'll provide a fully enumerated subprocessor list plus redacted sample agreements on request. If Acme requires raw contracts, we can coordinate via your procurement lead and our legal team.

I'll start the package build now.

Best,
Logan Wright
Director, Security & Trust Operations | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

—Karthik
